voice.name: Antoine - Articulate, Calm and Bright
voice.why: A calm, articulate middle-aged French voice for the clinic doctor. The game has male bodies only; the voice is male.

what.text: I patch people up. A bandage stops bleeding. Anything worse, come to me before it gets worse.

where.text: If you need a bandage and I am not here, the general store keeps dressings by the counter.

rumour.text: A lot of cuts from the sawmill this month. The men will not wear gloves.
